_comment: FROZEN CONTRACT (PLAN_repo_fact_attribution.md Phase 0). Canonical machine-readable repo-provenance citation grammar shared by the agent emitter (oc-codecollab-plugin src/provenance.ts) and the becos parser (becos_memforest coding/provenance.py). The `cases` are AUTHORITATIVE: any parser on either side must reproduce them exactly. The `reference_regex` entries are documentation of the intended shape, not the contract.

grammar.value_charset: one-or-more chars that are not whitespace and not ']'

strip_rule: Remove every matched token span from the text, then collapse each run of horizontal whitespace left around a removal to a single space, then trim leading/trailing whitespace on each line. `[analysis]` and any bracket that is not a `repo:` token are NOT touched.

sentinels.analysis: [analysis] is not a repo token (no `repo:` key) -> zero tokens extracted, text unchanged. Signals author inference, not repo-derived fact.
sentinels.repo_unknown: [repo:unknown] parses as alias='unknown'. The PARSER still extracts it; the RESOLVER (Phase 2) treats 'unknown' as no-match -> ambient fallback.

cases.name: inline_prose_stripped
cases.input: Switched to Postgres in [repo:vonic_agent path:src/memory/store.py] because SQLite locked.
cases.stripped: Switched to Postgres in because SQLite locked.
